model_notes: Deductive change order CO-011 from Northgate Constructors for Riverbend Logistics Center – Building C, deleting the mezzanine office build-out. The change itself is the net deduct of ($110,983.75); the subtotal (116,825.00) and retained OH&P 5,841.25 are parts, and the original, prior and revised contract sums are totals. Both owner and contractor have signed the Accepted block; no conflicts found.

description.value: Delete the mezzanine office build-out (Rooms M-101 through M-108) from the Contract, including metal stud framing, gypsum board, acoustical ceilings, doors and hardware, and associated electrical rough-in.
